ops.text: Use pnpm, not npm, in this repo; never run npm install and delete any package-lock.json.
Store money as integer cents, never floats; convert with toCents and format with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts.
Do not add UI component libraries; build interface elements with the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button).
New blog posts must set `draft: true` in frontmatter until the user reviews them; never publish with `draft: false`.
Store post images in public/images/<post-slug>/ and use .webp format only; do not place them under src/assets.
Place test files next to the module they test, e.g. src/domain/budget.test.ts; never create a __tests__ folder.
Never hand-edit src/api/generated; add endpoints to openapi.yaml and regenerate them with pnpm gen:api.
Use npm for all package installs and scripts in this project; never use pnpm. Keep package-lock.json as the only lockfile and never create pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep business logic out of components: put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through a hook in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and route all date display and comparisons through src/lib/dates.ts (date-fns-tz, user's timezone); never compare raw local-time new Date() values.
Write all UI copy in British English spelling (colour, categorise, organisation); this is a UK product.
Default currency is GBP, not USD; this is a UK product, so new money displays and settings default to pounds.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings; keep headings plain text.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` and confirm both pass before reporting any task as done; CI runs lint.
Never commit or push changes unless the user explicitly asks; leave all work uncommitted so the user can review the diff.
